content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows users to create websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can host a storefront without incurring the costs associated with traditional e-commerce platforms. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge hefty fees (10% per sale), GitHub Pages eliminates these overheads. By utilizing NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% fee on sales, significantly increasing your net income. For instance, selling 100 units of a $97 product through Gumroad results in $921 lost to fees, whereas using GitHub Pages with NOWPayments keeps that revenue in your pocket. This infrastructure is crucial for creators looking to maximize their earnings and retain independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, GitHub Pages functions by serving static files directly from a GitHub repository. When you push your product files and webpage code to your GitHub repo, they are immediately accessible online. This architecture is complemented by backend logic implemented through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handles payment processing and order management. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly, enabling cryptocurrency payments with real-time conversion to USD. This combination ensures that your store remains operational, even in environments where traditional payment processors are unavailable. By leveraging these free tools, you maintain complete ownership and control over your digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment processing limitations, such as Nigeria, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or any digital product and find platforms like PayPal or Gumroad inaccessible or prohibitively expensive, GitHub Pages provides a viable alternative. It allows you to create a professional storefront without the burden of recurring fees or restrictive terms. This autonomy is essential for creators who want to build sustainable businesses in an increasingly digital world, where control over your revenue stream is paramount.
GitHub Pages allows you to host your store for free, maximizing your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your digital store hinges on several key components. First, you need a GitHub account to create and host your Pages site. Next, you'll utilize either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage backend processes, such as payment verification and order fulfillment. For file storage and delivery, you can utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which are free options. Finally, integrating NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions ensures that you can accept payments globally without the hurdles of traditional banking systems. Together, these components form a robust digital commerce stack that empowers creators to operate independently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your GitHub Pages digital store, first sign up for a GitHub account if you don't already have one. Create a new repository where you'll upload your product files and website code. Next, choose your backend solution—either Google Apps Script for simplicity or Cloudflare Workers for more complex logic. Configure your NOWPayments integration to handle cryptocurrency transactions, and set up your storage solution with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, publish your site via GitHub Pages and start marketing your digital products. For a comprehensive guide that includes all necessary blueprints and templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using GitHub Pages alongside NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This approach bypasses traditional payment processors and allows you to keep more of your revenue. By setting up your own digital store, you maintain control and avoid costly fees associated with other platforms.
NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees.

This kit provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. It includes key resources for setting up your store, ensuring you can operate smoothly within the financial landscape that limits many creators.
Your Deployment Checklist

Sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository. Upload your product files and website code to the repository. Choose between Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Set up file storage using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Configure your GitHub Pages to publish your online store. Start promoting your digital products to reach your audience.
